exemplars.paper_id: Liu et al. - 2010 - Passive Diagnosis for Wireless Sensor Networks

exemplars.paper_id: Li et al. - 2012 - FLIGHT clock calibration using fluorescent lighting

exemplars.method_signature: 光强采样→6阶低通滤波→周期检测→频率比估算

exemplars.paper_id: Zheng et al. - 2014 - ZiSense towards interference resilient duty cycling in wireless sensor networks
exemplars.key_insight: 基于RSSI时域序列特征(PAP R/空中时间/MPI/UNF)识别ZigBee信号,只在检测到ZigBee时才唤醒节点

exemplars.paper_id: Dong et al. - 2009 - Fine-grained boundary recognition in wireless ad hoc and sensor networks by topological methods

exemplars.paper_id: Guo et al. - 2010 - Perpendicular Intersection Locating Wireless Sensors With Mobile Beacon
exemplars.key_insight: 虽然RSSI绝对值不可靠，但RSSI差异能一致反映物理距离对比；移动时最大RSSI点即为传感器到轨迹的最短投影点
exemplars.method_signature: 利用移动信标轨迹上两点投影的垂直线交点计算传感器坐标，绕过RSSI绝对值映射

exemplars.paper_id: Dong et al. - 2012 - Bulk data dissemination in wireless sensor networks Modeling and analysis
exemplars.key_insight: 利用Dijkstra最短路径建模多跳传播，结合拓扑信息、竞争影响和流水线约束可准确估计完成时间
exemplars.method_signature: 分层解析模型：物理层(PRR)→单跳传播时间→多跳传播完成时间

exemplars.paper_id: Zheng et al. - 2017 - Interference Resilient Duty Cycling for Sensor Networks Under Co-Existing Environments
exemplars.key_insight: 通过RSSI时域序列特征(On-air时间、MPI、PAPR、UNF)识别ZigBee信号而非依赖能量阈值
exemplars.method_signature: 基于规则的时域RSSI特征提取与ZigBee识别

exemplars.paper_id: Liu and Li - 2007 - Iso-Map Energy-Efficient Contour Mapping in Wireless Sensor Networks
exemplars.key_insight: 等值线总长O(√n)，仅采集等值线节点即可捕捉轮廓而大幅省 traffic
exemplars.method_signature: 局部判别等值线节点→邻居回归求梯度→汇聚重建边界

exemplars.paper_id: Wang et al. - 2011 - Algorithms for local sensor synchronization
exemplars.key_insight: 只需与父子节点局部同步而非全局同步,可大幅降低频率
exemplars.method_signature: 动态规划求最优F_i + 启发式树拓扑优化

exemplars.paper_id: Wang et al. - 2014 - Sleep in the Dins Insomnia therapy for duty-cycled sensor networks
exemplars.key_insight: 睡眠间隔与唤醒时间需根据流量速率λ联合优化,固定参数设置必然导致能耗增加
exemplars.method_signature: LAD协议:在线估计流量λ,查表获取最优(ts,tw,td),自适应调整占空比

exemplars.paper_id: Liu et al. - 2012 - Mining Frequent Trajectory Patterns for Activity Monitoring Using Radio Frequency Tag Arrays
exemplars.venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
exemplars.key_insight: 利用物体穿过标签阵列时的信号干扰变化检测轨迹,无需在被追踪对象上安装设备
exemplars.method_signature: fault-tolerant sequential pattern mining

exemplars.paper_id: Jiang et al. - 2019 - 3D-OmniTrack 3D tracking with COTS RFID systems
exemplars.key_insight: 通过分析RFID信号传播的极化效应,将标签朝向变化映射为可计算的相位偏移,实现单标签同时追踪位置和朝向
exemplars.method_signature: 极化敏感相位模型 + MHT多假设追踪框架

exemplars.paper_id: Liu et al. - 2014 - Anchor-free backscatter positioning for RFID tags with high accuracy
exemplars.key_insight: 相位是稳定的位置指示器,且在可行区域内可放松三角形约束仍保证定位能力
exemplars.method_signature: 基于相位差的双曲定位,利用可行区域放松天线间距约束

exemplars.paper_id: Liu et al. - 2016 - BackPos High Accuracy Backscatter Positioning System
exemplars.key_insight: 相位差可消除标签初始相位旋转θ_TAG，且双曲线分支间区域满足三角形约束，从而放松天线间距要求
exemplars.method_signature: 基于相位差的双曲线定位，引入可行域放松λ/2天线间距约束

exemplars.paper_id: Yang et al. - 2014 - Tagoram real-time tracking of mobile RFID tags to high precision using COTS devices
exemplars.key_insight: Mobility creates virtual antenna array: treating tag as static while antennas move in opposite direction enables hologram construction
exemplars.method_signature: Differential Augmented Hologram (DAH) using phase differences to cancel diversity term c

exemplars.paper_id: 2021_TPDS_Privacy-preserving_Efficient_Federated-Learning_Model_Debugging
exemplars.key_insight: 利用训练日志中的模型更新差异先定位问题客户端，再分层分析样本影响函数
exemplars.method_signature: 分层影响分析：训练日志定位客户端 + 差分隐私影响函数定位样本

exemplars.paper_id: 2023_MobiHoc_DP_DOCO
exemplars.key_insight: 批量更新策略在减少DP噪声(大批量)和保持模型更新速度(小批量)之间存在基本权衡，最优 τ=Θ(d/ε) 可同时改善两者
exemplars.method_signature: PDOM (Private DOCO with Optimal Mini-batch)，含PDOM-O和PDOM-S两种设置，使用拉普拉斯机制添加DP噪声

exemplars.paper_id: 2025_SIGCOMM2025_SCX
exemplars.key_insight: 利用Transformer前后向传播的顺序性,仅保留首尾层密钥即可锁定推理,中间层密钥可共享降低通信复杂度
exemplars.method_signature: 三阶段编码+令牌置换+冗余嵌入+拉普拉斯噪声,实现O(T+L)通信复杂度

exemplars.paper_id: DP_DOCO
exemplars.key_insight: 最优batch大小 τ 平衡了DP噪声水平与模型更新速度，而非批量更新是τ=1的次优特例
exemplars.method_signature: PDOM: mini-batch策略 + 最优batch大小选择算法

exemplars.paper_id: 2023_PerCom_GFL__Federated_Learning_on_Non_IID_data_via_Privacy_preserving_Synthetic_data
exemplars.key_insight: 用DPGAN生成带随机分布的合成数据，上传服务器后取IID子集平衡分布，并用epoch decay逐步减少合成数据使用以对抗mode collapse
exemplars.method_signature: GFL: DPGAN生成隐私保护合成数据→服务器IID化→带epoch decay的FL聚合

exemplars.paper_id: Gong et al. - 2016 - Fast Composite Counting in RFID Systems
exemplars.key_insight: 用hash函数将标签ID映射为均匀分布的小样本(synopsis),可在synopsis上直接做集合运算来估计原集合表达式基数
exemplars.method_signature: 基于hash的 synopsis 采样 + 集合代数操作估计基数,通信复杂度达到下界的对数因子内

exemplars.paper_id: Gong et al. - 2017 - Toward More Rigorous and Practical Cardinality Estimation for Large-Scale RFID Systems
exemplars.key_insight: 用 pairwise-independent 哈希做粗估计保证常数倍精度,再用t-wise-independent哈希精化,无需完美哈希也能实现严格有界精度
exemplars.method_signature: RPC两阶段方案:第一阶段pairwise独立哈希+loglog计数,第二阶段t-wise独立哈希球箱模型精化

exemplars.paper_id: Qian et al. - 2011 - Cardinality Estimation for Large-Scale RFID Systems
exemplars.venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
exemplars.key_insight: 碰撞不再被视为资源浪费,而是将碰撞槽排列成有序模式从中提取基数信息
exemplars.method_signature: Lottery Frame (LoF): 几何分布哈希+ALOHA时隙+右端零位置估计

exemplars.paper_id: Liu et al. - 2014 - Generic Composite Counting in RFID Systems
exemplars.key_insight: 用小规模synopsis代替完整tag集,通过hash值排序和Jaccard相似度分解,实现任意集合表达式的概率估计
exemplars.method_signature: 基于slotted ALOHA的synopsis收集协议,使用binary search提取k个最小hash值,O(k log n)通信开销

exemplars.paper_id: Qian et al. - 2008 - Cardinality Estimation for Large-scale RFID Systems
exemplars.key_insight: 利用几何分布哈希让标签选择时隙,OR合并位图消除重复,帧长仅需O(log n)
exemplars.method_signature: Lottery Frame (LoF)利用几何分布哈希函数+位图OR合并实现复制不敏感估计

exemplars.paper_id: He et al. - 2017 - Pervasive Floorplan Generation Based on Only Inertial Sensing Feasibility, Design, and Implementati
exemplars.key_insight: People's behavior offers meaningful clues—turns at corners and stationary stops at featured locations (water dispensers) enable labeling pathlets for progressive bundling into floorplans.
exemplars.method_signature: Nail (featured location) + TriNail (triangle of three Nails) as minimal stable structure for robust pathlet bundling under noisy conditions.

exemplars.paper_id: Wu et al. - 2015 - PhaseU Real-time LOS identification with WiFi
exemplars.key_insight: 天线间相位差的方差在 NLOS 条件下更大,且加权多子载波可放大该差异
exemplars.method_signature: 利用天线空间分集+子载波频率分集,提出 ρ 因子特征进行实时二元判决

exemplars.paper_id: Zhang et al. - 2017 - Montage Combine Frames with Movement Continuity for Realtime Multi-User Tracking
exemplars.key_insight: 距离向量与运动向量满足D_ij(t_u+1)=M_j-M_i方程,利用测距+运动向量的双重约束可消除定位歧义
exemplars.method_signature: 用Gold码编码音频同时测距多用户,惯性传感器估计步长和方向,向量方程连接连续快照追踪轨迹

exemplars.paper_id: Huang et al. - 2015 - Swadloon Direction Finding and Indoor Localization Using Acoustic Signal by Shaking Smartphones
exemplars.key_insight: 相对位移与相位偏移成正比，PLL可跟踪相位实现亚毫米级位移分辨率
exemplars.method_signature: 利用PLL跟踪声学多普勒相位频率偏移，结合惯性传感器数据线性回归求解方向

exemplars.paper_id: Liu et al. - 2021 - EyeLoc Smartphone Vision-Enabled Plug-n-Play Indoor Localization in Large Shopping Malls
exemplars.key_insight: 利用公开可用的楼层平面图图像和手机视觉模仿人类自定位行为
exemplars.method_signature: 基于三点几何约束的圆弧相交定位模型

exemplars.paper_id: 2015_MobiCom
exemplars.key_insight: 利用人眼与相机之间的有限差异（色温混合、闪烁临界频率、滚动快门），设计可被人类视觉融合但导致相机记录失真的帧序列
exemplars.method_signature: 将原始帧分解为多个子帧：色度帧分解+亮度帧污染+空间形变，人眼融合为原始色彩，相机记录产生严重失真

exemplars.paper_id: Zhang et al. - 2015 - Kaleido You Can Watch It But Cannot Record It
exemplars.key_insight: Exploit limited disparities between human vision (low-pass, temporal fusion) and camera (rolling shutter, sampling) to create imperceptible flicker for eyes but distorted recording for camera
exemplars.method_signature: Re-encode video by decomposing frames into chromatic flickers above CFF and illuminance perturbations; human fuses, camera distorts

exemplars.paper_id: Zhang et al. - 2018 - ChromaCode A Fully Imperceptible Screen-Camera Communication System
exemplars.key_insight: 利用CIELAB感知均匀色彩空间+CIEDE2000公式可精确控制感知色差，从而在保证不可见性的同时最大化吞吐量
exemplars.method_signature: 基于CIELAB空间的 outcome-driven 自适应亮度嵌入+RS+卷积级联纠错码

exemplars.paper_id: Zhang et al. - 2021 - ChromaCode A Fully Imperceptible Screen-Camera Communication System
exemplars.key_insight: 利用CIELAB均匀色空间和CIEDE2000色差公式，使亮度变化在感知上均匀一致
exemplars.method_signature: 基于感知均匀色空间的逐像素结果驱动自适应嵌入+RS+卷积级联纠错码

exemplars.paper_id: 2023_INFOCOM_Feature_Selection
exemplars.key_insight: 先用Gini impurity初始化特征重要性(仅需2次通信),再通过随机双门(stochastic dual-gates)在训练中动态筛选特征,实现高效安全选择
exemplars.method_signature: Gini impurity初始化 + 高斯随机双门 + PHE加密 + 噪声机制

exemplars.paper_id: 2017_TPDS_PIC_Enable_Large-Scale_Privacy_Preserving_Content-Based_Image_Search_on_Cloud
exemplars.venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
exemplars.key_insight: 多层次同态加密配合密钥转换实现云端密文运算，关键代理解密距离而非特征向量
exemplars.method_signature: 双层搜索(聚类匹配+近邻搜索)结合MapReduce并行化

exemplars.paper_id: 2022_BIGCOM_tanjuntao-final
exemplars.key_insight: 当特征数大于batch大小时，线性系统唯一解可直接求出残差，从而泄露标签
exemplars.method_signature: 三种残差保护机制：加性噪声、乘性噪声、结合LDP与HE的混合机制

exemplars.paper_id: Zhang et al. - 2017 - PIC Enable Large-Scale Privacy Preserving Content-Based Image Search on Cloud
exemplars.key_insight: 利用多层同态加密将密钥管理与计算分离,实现非交互式隐私保护搜索
exemplars.method_signature: 基于多层同态加密+MapReduce的隐私保护图像搜索系统

exemplars.paper_id: Xu et al. - 2016 - Indoor localization via multi-modal sensing on smartphones
exemplars.key_insight: 利用传感器丰富的照片结合语义信息提取,无需预校准即可建立图像空间到物理空间的映射
exemplars.method_signature: 传感器融合+语义几何推理+流形对齐的多模态定位

exemplars.paper_id: Huang et al. - 2014 - Shake and walk Acoustic direction finding and fine-grained indoor localization using smartphones
exemplars.key_insight: 用相位锁环(PLL)替代FFT追踪相位变化,可突破时频分辨率限制,实现亚毫米位移测量精度。
exemplars.method_signature: Swadloon结合声学PLL与惯性传感器的多普勒方向发现,经线性回归融合两路速度。

exemplars.paper_id: Wu et al. - 2017 - Mitigating Large Errors in WiFi-Based Indoor Localization for Smartphones
exemplars.key_insight: 移动用户采集的指纹是当前位与历史位的RSS混合体，需用幻影指纹匹配
exemplars.method_signature: 幻影指纹+鲁棒回归+区分因子，统一指纹相似度度量

exemplars.paper_id: Huang et al. - 2013 - Accurate Indoor Localization Using Acoustic Direction Finding via Smart Phones
exemplars.key_insight: 手机摇晃的相对位移和速度对应于接收声信号的多普勒相位和频率细微偏移
exemplars.method_signature: 声学多普勒定向+PLL相位跟踪+惯性传感器融合+锚点三角定位

exemplars.paper_id: Li et al. - 2010 - Multicast Capacity of Wireless Ad Hoc Networks Under Gaussian Channel Model
exemplars.key_insight: Use percolation theory to construct highway system enabling optimal per-flow multicast rate Θ(1/√(nk)) in random networks
exemplars.method_signature: Bond percolation on grid creates open paths forming highways; construct Euclidean spanning trees to relay multicast data

exemplars.paper_id: Li et al. - 2008 - Capacity of large scale wireless networks under Gaussian channel model
exemplars.key_insight: Percolation theory enables constructing highway system that achieves per-flow rate Ω(√n/(ns√k)), generalizing unicast capacity results
exemplars.method_signature: Bond percolation on grid forms highways; Euclidean spanning tree for multicast; TDMA scheduling on short hops

exemplars.paper_id: Wang et al. - 2013 - Asymptotic throughput for large-scale wireless networks with general node density
exemplars.key_insight: 用动脉道路系统取代渗透理论高速公路系统，可在某些n_d区间取得更优吞吐量
exemplars.method_signature: 普通动脉道路M_o与平行动脉道路M_p双scheme协同，根据λ/ns/nd选择最优

exemplars.paper_id: Wang et al. - 2009 - Scaling Laws on Multicast Capacity of Large Scale Wireless Networks
exemplars.key_insight: 引入第二类高速公路(second-class highway)配合第一类高速公路形成双层架构,并行调度附近链路,避免访问高速的瓶颈
exemplars.method_signature: 基于渗透理论构造双层高速公路路由,结合 TDMA 调度与集中度分析证明上下界匹配

exemplars.paper_id: Liao et al. - 2006 - AnySee Peer-to-Peer Live Streaming
exemplars.key_insight: 允许节点同时加入多个overlay形成备份路径集,可跨overlay寻找最近节点服务从而改善全局资源分配
exemplars.method_signature: inter-overlay优化管理器+mesh底层+reverse tracing探测+key节点 admission control

exemplars.paper_id: Xiao et al. - 2006 - Mutual anonymous overlay multicast
exemplars.venue: Journal of Parallel and Distributed Computing
exemplars.key_insight: 匿名multicast必须围绕树结构而非多播unicast；invite MO节点可将AM比例控制在~50%阈值以保持效率
exemplars.method_signature: MAM协议含AM-NM单向anon、AM-AM双向anon协议及树构造与MO邀请优化

exemplars.paper_id: Xiao et al. - 2004 - Prioritized Overlay Multicast in Mobile Ad Hoc Environments
exemplars.key_insight: Application-layer priority filtering enables nodes to switch between trees based on importance, with location info guiding efficient tree formation
exemplars.method_signature: Priority token-based tree formation with location-aware orphan handling and DSR as underlying unicast

exemplars.paper_id: Liu et al. - 2005 - Efficient data retrieving in distributed data-streaming environments
exemplars.key_insight: 多棵独立的多播树能利用更多物理链路，比单棵树更均匀地分散流量
exemplars.method_signature: 分布式MMT协议，端主机自组织成多棵多播树，碎片合并迭代构建

exemplars.paper_id: Xi et al. - 2010 - Locating sensors in the wild pursuit of ranging quality
exemplars.key_insight: 只有少数节点测距准确；用所有节点不加区分地进行校准反而会让结果变差
exemplars.method_signature: CDL结合虚拟跳数定位、本地过滤和逐级测距质量校准三阶段迭代流程

exemplars.paper_id: Yang and Liu - 2010 - Quality of Trilateration Confidence-Based Iterative Localization
exemplars.key_insight: Different geometric forms of trilaterations provide different accuracy levels; QoT enables selecting best trilaterations and avoiding flip ambiguity.

exemplars.paper_id: Liu et al. - 2010 - Location, Localization, and Localizability
exemplars.key_insight: 误差控制和网络可定位性理论是定位研究的两个关键新兴方向,需同时考虑
exemplars.method_signature: 综述分类现有方法,提出误差控制与可定位性分析框架

exemplars.paper_id: Wang et al. - 2010 - ETOC Obtaining robustness in component-based localization
exemplars.key_insight: A single node suffers only translation, but components suffer three transformations (translation, rotation, reflection), requiring new robust patterns beyond existing flip-ambiguity methods
exemplars.method_signature: ETOC uses robust coordinate system conversion patterns to achieve guaranteed localization robustness

exemplars.paper_id: Ni et al. - 2003 - ANDMARC Indoor Location Sensing Using Active RFID
exemplars.venue: IEEE International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Communications (PerCom)
exemplars.key_insight: Use extra fixed reference tags as calibration landmarks; comparing signal strength patterns between reference and tracking tags compensates for environmental dynamics.
exemplars.method_signature: k-nearest neighbor using Euclidean distance in signal strength space, weighted by inverse-square E value.

exemplars.paper_id: Ni et al. - 2004 - LANDMARC Indoor Location Sensing Using Active RFID
exemplars.key_insight: Reference tags experiencing identical environmental effects as tracking tags enable relative signal-strength comparison for location estimation.
exemplars.method_signature: k-nearest neighbor with inverse-square weighted Euclidean distance in signal-strength space

exemplars.paper_id: Zhao et al. - 2007 - VIRE Active RFID-based Localization Using Virtual Reference Elimination
exemplars.key_insight: 通过线性插值生成虚拟参考标签,结合消除算法过滤不可能位置
exemplars.method_signature: 虚拟参考标签+邻近图+阈值消除+加权坐标计算

exemplars.paper_id: Xu et al. - 2018 - Embracing Spatial Awareness for Reliable WiFi-Based Indoor Location Systems
exemplars.key_insight: 相邻位置间的RSS差值比单点RSS值更稳定，可利用RSS空间梯度矩阵作为指纹
exemplars.method_signature: ViViPlus系统：RSG矩阵指纹替代RSS向量，联合解决空间歧义与时间漂移

exemplars.paper_id: Yang et al. - 2012 - Locating in fingerprint space wireless indoor localization with little human intervention
